novel.justification: This note maintains path-uniform interiority, which is stronger than fixed-penalty interiority. A concrete sufficient route is that the unique interior optimizer depends continuously on \(c\), \(\mathcal C\) is compact, and its image lies in the interior of \(\Theta\); continuity of the boundary-distance map then gives a positive uniform \(\rho\). This holds, for example, when bounded features and outcomes and a benchmark bounded away from zero yield a continuous softmax criterion and the optimizer image is contained in a compact subset of \(\operatorname{int}(\Theta)\).
